system.description:
You may make a [Normal Move] up to your [Speed] Sq. During this Main Process, if you deal at least 1 point of HP Damage to a target with an attack, that target takes [Dazed].

(Minor): Increase the distance moved by +1 Sq.

A special skill that moves in a way that dazzles the enemy with unstable movements. Enemies miss the battle's reach as if in a haze.
